observations.detail: Verdict: 'कल' is acceptable; no change requested. Hindi 'कल' means both yesterday and tomorrow, and this catalogue already uses it for both ('कल सुबह 9:00 बजे' for a future time, and 'कल {time}' in a yesterday select arm), so the wider catalogue relies on context. Here the context is unambiguous: the heading sits in the activity-ordered chats list between 'आज' and 'इस हफ़्ते' (past windows, newest first), and the same list's Older section follows. 'कल' is also the wording the common-time and notifications catalogues already ship for yesterday, so a short, consistent heading beats 'बीता कल' (a second wording for one concept, and longer). Residual weakness, not a finding: the reorder accessible names read '{section} ऊपर ले जाएँ' → 'कल ऊपर ले जाएँ' with no neighbouring headings, where a screen-reader user could momentarily parse 'tomorrow'; the same sentence frame is shared by every section and the row sits in a 'Sections' list beside 'आज' and 'इस हफ़्ते'. If the product later wants belt and braces, 'बीता कल' is the drop-in; it would need re-audit of the three catalogues together. Devanagari is caseless so CSS uppercase is a no-op. Length 2 code points vs maxCells 20.
